attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 12, `periplasmic protein` to `iclR`, are carried by 97 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 42% of calls. The model names 89 to 99.6% of them, fewest at column 7, `yjbD`, 89%.

**A single fork column breaks the first spine**: column 13, carried by 42%, all shell, the most plastic stretch of the window. Further along, columns 68 to 71, `frwB` to `fsa`, are [[fructose transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 93%, and hesitates less there, 0.15 against 0.22 bits. Its most hesitant column, 13, is a fork column, at 0.66 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 66 to 79, `pflC` to `metB`, are carried by 47 to 88% of chromosomes, 13 persistent and 1 shell. The last column is `metB`, in 47% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 96% of genes**, 0.17 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.46 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 96%.

label: periplasmic protein
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the periplasmic protein window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor periplasmic protein, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,101 to 4,180 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying periplasmic protein once); 42,719 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.17 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,794 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 4,841 calls, named 81%, 0.54 bits; cloud 84 calls, named 33%, 1.41 bits. Outside an RGP 40,282 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 2,437 calls, named 88%, 0.46 bits. Columns: 62 spine, 5 fork, 13 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.46 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 96%); 2,437 of the 42,719 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 13 ("PTS mannose/fructose/sorbose transporte…", a fork column) 0.66 bits, RGP 42%; column 9 (pepE, a spine column) 0.61 bits, RGP 38%; column 7 (yjbD, a spine column) 0.58 bits, RGP 4%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 62 spine columns: named 97%, 0.15 bits on average; the 18 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.22 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 13, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 13 (fork), RGP 42%; the least: column 52 (variable), RGP 0.4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-12 (13 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0-42%. Genes: "periplasmic protein", yjbH "YjbH domain-containing protein", yjbG "capsule biosynthesis GfcC family pr…", yjbF "YjbF family lipoprotein", yjbE "exopolysaccharide production protei…", pgi, lysC, yjbD "DUF3811 domain-containing protein", rluF, pepE, yjbB "Na/Pi cotransporter family protein", metH, iclR. named 89-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 7 (yjbD), named 89%; most hesitant at column 9 (pepE), 0.61 bits.
[S2] 2. column 13 fork: share 42%, all S, RGP 42%. named 76%; 0.66 bits.
[S2.c13]    13: "PTS mannose/fructose/sorbose transporte…" S 42%; also espL4 S 40%, "ShET2/EspL2 family type III secretion s…" S 23%, "IS1 family transposase" S 11%
[S3] 3. columns 14-18 (5 columns) spine: share 95-98%, all P, RGP 6-42%. Genes: aceK "bifunctional isocitrate dehydrogena…", aceA, aceB, metA, yjaB "acetyltransferase". named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18 (yjaB), named 95%, 0.38 bits.
[S4] 4. column 19 fork: share 49%, all S, RGP 4%. named 95%; 0.35 bits.
[S4.c19]    19: yjaA S 49% "YjaA family stress response protein"; also "hypothetical protein" S 11%
[S5] 5. columns 20-37 (18 columns) spine: share 94-97%, all P, RGP 3-4%. Genes: purH "bifunctional phosphoribosylaminoimi…", purD, zraR, zraS, zraP "zinc resistance sensor/chaperone Zr…", yjaH "DUF1481 domain-containing protein", hupA, yjaG "YjaG family protein", nfi, hemE, nudC, rsd, thiC, thiE, thiF, thiS, thiG "thiazole synthase", thiH. named 90-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (purH), named 90%, 0.37 bits.
[S6] 6. column 38 variable: share 67%, all S, RGP 2%. named 96%; 0.18 bits.
[S6.c38]    38: yjaZ S 67% "heat-shock protein C"
[S7] 7. columns 39-51 (13 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 0.4-1%. Genes: rpoC, rpoB "DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit…", rplL, rplJ, rplA "50S ribosomal protein L1", rplK, nusG, secE, tuf, coaA, birA, murB, murI "glutamate racemase". named 94-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 51 (murI), named 94%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.14 bits (column 44 (rplK)).
[S8] 8. column 52 variable: share 69%, all S, RGP 0.4%. named 95%; 0.14 bits.
[S8.c52]    52: btuB S 69%
[S9] 9. columns 53-65 (13 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 1-4%. Genes: trmA, yijD "YijD family membrane protein", fabR, sthA, oxyR, argH, argB "acetylglutamate kinase", argC, argE, ppc, eptC, yijO "AraC family transcriptional regulat…", frwD. named 93-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 62 (ppc), named 93%, 0.20 bits.
[S10] 10. columns 66-79 (14 columns) fork and variable columns: share 47-88%, 13 P, 1 S, RGP 1-4%. named 74-98% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 78, named 74%; most hesitant at column 67, 0.28 bits.
[S10.c66]    66 variable: pflC P 88% "[formate-C-acetyltransferase]-activ…"
[S10.c67]    67 fork: pflD P 87%; also "MFS transporter" S 16%
[S10.c68]    68 fork: frwB P 86%; also manD S 16%
[S10.c69-78]    columns 69-78 variable, share 51-81%, 9 P, 1 S: frwC "PTS fructose transporter subunit EI…" 81%, ptsP 78%, fsa 76%, gldA 72%, yijF "DUF1287 domain-containing protein" 68%, yijE "cystine transporter YijE" 61%, katG 58%, metF 56%, "hypothetical protein" 53%, metL "bifunctional aspartate kinase/homos…" 51%
